Hasil RUPS PT LIB Ganti Nama Jadi I League: Liga 1 Jadi BRI Super League, Liga 2 Jadi Pegadaian Championship |website=Bola.com |last=Yaksa |first=Muhammad Adi |date=7 July 2025 |access-date=7 July 2025 |language=id}}) was the inaugural season of the [[Super League (Indonesia)|Super League]] under its current name and the 16th season of the top-flight Indonesian football league since its establishment in 2008. The season began on 8 August 2025 and concluded on 23 May 2026,{{Cite web |url=https://www.bola.com/indonesia/read/6098430/pt-lib-pastikan-liga-1-20252026-dimulai-8-agustus-berlangsung-9-bulan |title=PT LIB Pastikan Liga 1 2025/2026 Dimulai 8 Agustus, Berlangsung 9 Bulan |website=Bola.com |last=Yaksa |first=Muhammad Adi |date=7 July 2025 |access-date=22 July 2025 |language=id}} which included a break from 1 to 19 December 2025 in conjunction with the [[2025 SEA Games|SEA Games]] in [[Thailand]].{{Cite web |last=Susila |first=Abdul |date=9 April 2025 |title=Hasil Rapat LIB dengan Kluivert-Vanenburg: Liga 1 Libur Saat SEA Games |url=https://cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20250409161557-142-1217187/hasil-rapat-lib-dengan-kluivert-vanenburg-liga-1-libur-saat-sea-games |access-date=20 May 2025 |website=CNN Indonesia |language=id}} The summer [[transfer window]] ran from 24 June to 11 September 2025, while the winter transfer window ran from 2 January to 28 February 2026. [[Persib Bandung|Persib]] were the [[List of Indonesian football champions|defending champions]] after winning their 3rd Liga 1 title and 9th overall Indonesian top-flight football title in the previous season.{{cite web |title=Akhirnya Persib Juara di Musim Reguler Era Liga Indonesia |work=detiksport |url=https://sport.detik.com/sepakbola/liga-indonesia/d-7901618/akhirnya-persib-juara-di-musim-reguler-era-liga-indonesia |last1=Robbani |first1=Muhammad |date=6 May 2025 }} == Overview == The league was contested by 18 teams. This was made up of fifteen teams from the previous season and three teams promoted from [[2024–25 Liga 2 (Indonesia)|Liga 2]].{{Cite web |url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20250525093252-142-1232886/daftar-resmi-18-klub-peserta-liga-1-2025-2026 |title=Daftar Resmi 18 Klub Peserta Liga 1 2025/2026 |website=CNN Indonesia |date=25 May 2025 |access-date=25 May 2025 |language=id}} Three teams were relegated at the end of the previous season. [[PSIS Semarang|PSIS]] were the first to be relegated on 11 May 2025 after [[Semen Padang F.C.|Semen Padang]] had a draw with [[Persebaya Surabaya|Persebaya]] in an away match during matchweek 32. The result ended PSIS's seven-season stay in the first-tier.{{Cite web|last=Rifqi Karami |first=Luzman |url=https://viva.co.id/bola/liga-indonesia/1822582-psis-semarang-resmi-jadi-tim-pertama-yang-degradasi-dari-liga-1-musim-ini?page=all |title=PSIS Semarang Resmi Jadi Tim Pertama yang Degradasi dari Liga 1 Musim Ini |website=VIVA.co.id |date=12 May 2025 |access-date=12 May 2025 |language=id}} The other two teams to be relegated were [[PSS Sleman|PSS]] and [[PS Barito Putera|Barito Putera]] with the results of each match in final matchweek. Despite winning over [[Madura United F.C.|Madura United]], PSS were relegated after six seasons in the top tier. [[PS Barito Putera|Barito Putera]]'s win over PSIS on the final day did not keep them in the division, for the first time in 12 years.{{Cite web |last=Farhan |first=Afif |url=https://sport.detik.com/sepakbola/liga-indonesia/d-7930576/hasil-liga-1-pss-dan-barito-putera-susul-psis-degradasi |title=Hasil Liga 1: PSS dan Barito Putera Susul PSIS Degradasi! |website=Detik.com |date=24 May 2025 |access-date=24 May 2025 |language=id}} Three teams were promoted from Liga 2. [[Bhayangkara Presisi Lampung F.C.|Bhayangkara Presisi]] secured promotion following a win over [[Persijap Jepara|Persijap]] in matchweek 5 of Group Y in the championship round.{{Cite web|last=Melati |first=Metta Rahma |url=https://bolasport.com/read/314216082/hasil-pertandingan-liga-2-imbang-lawan-persijap-bhayangkara-fc-promosi-ke-liga-1 |title=Hasil Pertandingan Liga 2 - Imbang Lawan Persijap, Bhayangkara FC Promosi ke Liga 1 |website=Bolasport |date=12 February 2025 |access-date=12 February 2025 |language=id}} [[PSIM Yogyakarta|PSIM]] were promoted following a win over [[PSPS Pekanbaru|PSPS]] in matchweek 6 of Group X in the championship round. This season marked PSIM's return to the top tier after 18 years.{{Cite web|last=|first=|url=https://cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20250217170748-142-1199272/psim-yogyakarta-akhiri-penantian-18-tahun-sukses-promosi-ke-liga-1 |title=PSIM Yogyakarta Akhiri Penantian 18 Tahun, Sukses Promosi ke Liga 1 |website=CNN Indonesia |date=17 February 2025 |access-date=17 February 2025 |language=id}} [[Persijap Jepara|Persijap]] won the divisional promotion play-off in a game against PSPS. This marked Persijap's return to the top tier after 10 seasons of absence, including two seasons in the third tier.{{Cite web|last=Pasi |first=Serafin Unus |url=https://bola.net/indonesia/selamat-persijap-jepara-jadi-tim-terakhir-yang-promisi-ke-bri-liga-1-2025-2026-b0d3f6.html |title=Selamat! Persijap Jepara Jadi Tim Terakhir yang Promisi ke BRI Liga 1 2025/2026 |website=Bola.net |date=25 February 2025 |access-date=25 February 2025 |language=id}} Starting from this season, [[I-League (Indonesia)|I-League]] announced an increase in the foreign player quota to a maximum of 11 per club.
